verdict.rationale: Gecko publishes a v1 API reference section covering scans, repositories, vulnerabilities, triage, schedules and webhooks, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is live at /openapi.json. Together these give AI-native users a structured, explorable API surface. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, so only the reference half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable request/response examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of the API docs experience.
